recorded.prompt:q-draft-invoice: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-draft-invoice: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-draft-invoice: The first section decides it: the output shows 'after three get() calls: 3 queries' and 'same object each time: false', and the text says 'each get() ran the body again and returned a new table... two get() calls in one method worked on two different tables', so each addLine and the save() each got a fresh draft from newDraft().
recorded.prompt:q-cas-catalog: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cas-catalog: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cas-catalog: Lines 97-99 decide it: the compareAndSet memo 'fixes only the inconsistency: in the same test both callers always saw the same table, and the load still ran twice', and the reference table gives '2, one kept'. The page tested only two threads and its memo had no non-null fast path, but 'can run in several threads' is a fair reading of that result.
recorded.prompt:q-signing-key: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-signing-key: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-signing-key: Lines 172-179 decide it: the output shows 'holder, 2nd: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: Could not initialize class Rates$Holder' after the database came back, and the text says 'A class whose initialiser threw is marked as failed, and the JVM never runs it again. Every later table() throws NoClassDefFoundError until the process restarts'.
recorded.prompt:q-digest-threads: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-digest-threads: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-digest-threads: Lines 263-264 decide it: withInitial 'calls the supplier on a thread's first get() and keeps the result for that thread', and the output shows 'withInitial: 2 threads x 1000 get() -> 2 formatters'. The reference table adds 'and again after remove()', which this stem never triggers.
recorded.prompt:q-heap-gauge: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-heap-gauge: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-heap-gauge: Lines 310-312 and 377-378 decide it: the primitive suppliers 'are separate interfaces, not subtypes of Supplier, so one doesn't go where the other is expected'; 'none extends Supplier'; and a compile error is shown for the IntSupplier case. The page shows the error for IntSupplier, not DoubleSupplier, but names DoubleSupplier in the same rule. Note: the lambda body returns a long into a DoubleSupplier, a widening the page never covers.
